topic.service: Lead-safe remodeling of pre-1978 homes: RRP certified firms, permits, containment and cleaning verification

sources.title: https://app.leg.wa.gov/WAC/default.aspx?cite=365-230-300
sources.supports: Applicability to renovations for compensation in target housing and child-occupied facilities; exceptions: inspector/risk assessor written determination, EPA-recognized test kit by certified renovator per component, paint chip lab; 1.0 mg/cm2 or 0.5% by weight; emergency renovations still subject to cleaning and cleaning verification

sources.title: https://app.leg.wa.gov/WAC/default.aspx?cite=365-230-320
sources.supports: Pamphlet no more than sixty days before renovation; owner written acknowledgment or certificate of mailing at least seven days prior; adult occupant if owner not occupying

sources.title: https://app.leg.wa.gov/WAC/default.aspx?cite=365-230-330
sources.supports: Work practice standards: certified firms using certified renovators; warning signs in occupants' primary language until cleaning verification; interior containment (objects, ducts, windows/doors, entry plastic, floor six feet); egress; exterior: close doors/windows within twenty feet, ground cover ten feet, vertical containment within ten feet of property line; prohibited open-flame, high-speed removal without shroud and HEPA, heat gun below 1,100 F; waste contained, covered chute, stored under containment; cleaning within two feet, higher to lower, HEPA with beater bar, two-bucket mop; cleaning verification card procedure; exterior visual inspection; remove signs after passing

sources.title: https://app.leg.wa.gov/WAC/default.aspx?cite=365-230-380
sources.supports: Renovator certification; EPA or authorized-state certification registered with department; expiration not exceeding original

sources.title: https://app.leg.wa.gov/wac/default.aspx?cite=365-230
sources.supports: Chapter 365-230 WAC: accreditation of lead-based paint training programs and certification of firms and individuals conducting lead-based paint activities and renovation

sources.title: https://blue.kingcounty.com/Assessor/eRealProperty/default.aspx
sources.supports: King County Assessor eReal Property parcel search (year built lookup)

sources.title: https://cdnsm5-hosted.civiclive.com/UserFiles/Servers/Server_11045935/File/Business/Building%20&%20Construction/Permit%20Center/Fact%20Sheets%20and%20Fee%20Tables/Required%20Permits%20for%20Single%20Family%20Residences.pdf
sources.supports: When Are Permits Required (Residential), effective February 1, 2021: interior remodels require permit; exterior doors, windows and skylights requiring new opening or in Airport Noise Zone 1 require permit; painting, papering, tiling, carpeting, cabinets, countertops exempt; most nonstructural siding replacement exempt; call City Hall if unsure

sources.title: https://doh.wa.gov/community-and-environment/contaminants/lead
sources.supports: DOH lead page: Lead Safe from the Start questionnaire (parents of child under 6; pregnant people); contact county health department for local services

sources.supports: State hiring guidance: registration, bids, written contract

sources.supports: License/bond/insurance lookup

sources.supports: Material: drop cloths, dust barrier systems, heavy duty surface protection, protective films

sources.supports: Material: disposable and reusable respirators, powered and supplied air systems

sources.title: https://www.burienwa.gov/business/community_development
sources.supports: Building Division processes construction, electrical, fire alarm, fire sprinkler, plumbing, mechanical and sign permits

sources.title: https://www.burienwa.gov/business/community_development/permit_center
sources.supports: Permit Center: intake, review, tracking, issuing permits; Planning, Building, Public Works staff; MyBuildingPermit paperless portal; in-person Mon-Thu 9-noon; phone/email Mon-Thu 9-4; closed Fridays and noon-1 daily; 400 SW 152nd St Suite 300; (206) 241-4647

sources.title: https://www.commerce.wa.gov/lead-based-paint/
sources.supports: Commerce Lead-Based Paint programs: training, certification, compliance enforcement; LBPA (inspection, risk assessment, clearance, abatement 20+ years) vs RRP (not intended to permanently remove hazards); RRP needed to offer/bid/contract on pre-1978 residential and child-occupied facilities; remodels, painting, restoration, any paint-disturbing work; RRP certs up to 5 years, LBPA 3 years; LBPInfo@Commerce.wa.gov, 360-586-5323 voicemail

sources.title: https://www.commerce.wa.gov/lead-based-paint/lbp-training/
sources.supports: Renovator training 8-hour class incl. 2 hours hands-on; required every 5 years; online refreshers valid 3 years every other cycle

sources.title: https://www.commerce.wa.gov/lead-based-paint/rrp/
sources.supports: RRP certification paths; firm needs individual RRP-certified employee/owner, cert valid and not within six months of expiration, who supervises or performs work; DOR account, WA business license, SOS registration if applicable, L&I contractor license if applicable; individuals certified via WA-accredited training provider; EPA/other-state certified individuals must register with Commerce

sources.title: https://www.epa.gov/lead/lead-renovation-repair-and-painting-program
sources.supports: EPA RRP program (federal) landing page

sources.title: https://www.epa.gov/lead/renovate-right
sources.supports: Renovate Right pamphlet: general information about legal requirements for lead-safe work practices for homeowners, tenants, childcare providers and parents

sources.title: https://www.epa.gov/lead/renovation-repair-and-painting-program-work-practices
sources.supports: Work practices: containment, prohibition of open-flame and power tools without HEPA exhaust, cleanup and verification; records on job site (renovator certificates); records kept 3 years (designated renovator, test kit/paint chip results, pre-renovation education proof); links Hometime video U-3U1pcSIyg

sources.title: https://www.milwaukeetool.com/products/power-tools/dust-management
sources.supports: Material: dust extractors and attachments with HEPA filters
